messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v2.5.0-beta -> 5% canary (rollout_id=rollout_3300307777). Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.5.0-beta. Change window: 2026-03-22 07:00-08:00 UTC. Auto-advance every 5m.

julia: Heads-up: us-west showing p95 spike and a few 502s at ~07:02. Sampling traces point to repeated kv-cache evictions + retries.

pavan: Sample log: ```
2026-03-22T07:02:10Z pod/canary-xyz: kv_cache.eviction triggered: evicted=120 entries
2026-03-22T07:02:11Z proxy/us-west: upstream retry for req=rd-77 (retry_count=2)
```

sylvie: Options: 1) region-pin us-west back to v2.4.x and hold rollout, 2) drop global canary to 1% and continue, 3) immediate full rollback. Propose region-pin + hold. Quick vote? :eyes: 

oncall-sre: I can do region override + hold. Will also temporarily disable auto-advance. ETA ~3m.

ops-bot: Commands to run:
```
# pin us-west to previous stable
deployctl rollout region-override --id rollout_3300307777 --region us-west --target v2.4.3
# hold the rollout to stop auto-advancing
deployctl rollout hold --id rollout_3300307777
# optionally reduce global canary to 1%
deployctl rollout set-traffic --id rollout_3300307777 --global-canary 1%
```

deploy-bot: Applied: us-west -> v2.4.3 (100% us-west). Rollout state: HELD. Global canary reduced to 1% in remaining regions. Links: https://redwood.internal/rollouts/rollout_3300307777

julia: After pin, us-west errors back to baseline. Remaining canaries stable. I'll open a quick PR to add a conservative canary cache limit and note in release notes.

pavan: I'll run a targeted canary cache tuning job (reduce max_entries, enable eviction backoff) on remaining canary pods and post metrics in 10m.

sylvie: Consensus: region-pin + hold + config tuning. Reactions: :thumbsup: from julia, pavan, sylvie. If we see regressions in other regions after tuning we escalate to rollback. Keeping thread pinned for postmortem and release notes update.
